title: Instantiation interface bundling three stage theorems for the Wasm toplevel
intent: Bundle the three instantiation stages of the LambdaANF-to-Wasm backend (module instantiation, the instantiation invariants, and the post-instantiation reduction) into one theorem, instantiation_combined_INV_and_more, so the Wasm top-level correctness proof applies a single lemma and destructures its conclusion instead of re-wiring the three stages.
also_known_as: API theorem at an abstraction boundary

parent.name: instantiation_combined_INV_and_more
parent.statement:
Theorem instantiation_combined_INV_and_more : forall e fds num_funs module fenv main_lenv hs,
  NoDup (collect_function_vars (Efun fds e)) ->
  expression_restricted cenv (Efun fds e) ->
  correct_cenv_of_exp cenv (Efun fds e) ->
  num_funs = numOf_fundefs fds ->
  (Z.of_nat num_funs <= max_num_functions)%Z ->
  LambdaANF_to_Wasm nenv cenv penv (Efun fds e) = Ret (module, fenv, main_lenv) ->

exists sr fr,
  (* instantiate + post-instantiate *)
  instantiate' module hs sr fr /\
  INV fenv sr fr /\

  (* conclusions of module_instantiate_INV_and_more_hold *)

  inst_funcs (f_inst fr) = [:: 0%N & (funcidcs num_funs (N.of_nat num_custom_funs))] /\
  (* value relation holds for all funcs in fds *)
  (forall a , find_def a fds <> None ->
  	exists fidx : funcidx,
	    repr_funvar fenv a fidx /\
	    repr_val_LambdaANF_Wasm cenv fenv penv (Vfun (M.empty _) fds a) sr (f_inst fr) (Val_funidx fidx)) /\

  exists main_fn e' fns,
    main_fn = {| modfunc_type := 0%N (* [] -> [] *)
               ; modfunc_locals := map (fun _ : var => T_num T_i32) (collect_local_variables e)
               ; modfunc_body := e'
               |} /\
    s_funcs sr =
    [:: FC_func_native (Tf [::] [::]) (f_inst fr) main_fn
    &   map (fun f0 : wasm_function =>
             FC_func_native (Tf (repeat (T_num T_i32) (N.to_nat (type f0))) [::]) (f_inst fr)
             {| modfunc_type := type f0; modfunc_locals := locals f0; modfunc_body := body f0 |})
            fns
     ] /\
  (* links e and e' in main_fn above *)
  translate_body nenv cenv (create_local_variable_mapping (collect_local_variables e)) fenv penv e 0 = Ret e' /\
  (* translation of functions *)
  translate_functions nenv cenv fenv penv fds = Ret fns.

children.name: module_instantiate
children.statement:
Theorem module_instantiate : forall e module fenv venv (hs : host_state),
  correct_cenv_of_exp cenv e ->
  NoDup (collect_function_vars e) ->
  LambdaANF_to_Wasm nenv cenv penv e = Ret (module, fenv, venv) ->
  exists sr fr es_post,
  instantiate initial_store module [] (sr, fr, es_post).
children.closed_by: constructs sr, fr, es_post as witnesses and closes by `repeat split` over `instantiate`; `Unshelve. all: apply (Tf [] []).`

children.name: module_instantiate_INV_and_more_hold
children.statement:
Theorem module_instantiate_INV_and_more_hold : forall eAny e fds num_funs module fenv main_lenv sr f es_post,
  NoDup (collect_function_vars (Efun fds eAny)) ->
  expression_restricted cenv (Efun fds e) ->
  (forall (f : var) (t : fun_tag) (ys : seq var) (e : exp),
      find_def f fds = Some (t, ys, e) -> correct_cenv_of_exp cenv e) ->
  num_funs = numOf_fundefs fds ->
  (Z.of_nat num_funs <= max_num_functions)%Z ->
  LambdaANF_to_Wasm nenv cenv penv (Efun fds e) = Ret (module, fenv, main_lenv) ->
  (* instantiate with the two imported functions *)
  instantiate initial_store module [] (sr, f, es_post) ->

  (* invariants hold initially *)
  INV_instantiation sr f (num_funs + num_custom_funs) /\
  inst_funcs (f_inst f) = [:: 0%N & (funcidcs num_funs (N.of_nat num_custom_funs))] /\
  (* value relation holds for all funcs in fds *)
  (forall a, find_def a fds <> None ->
	   exists fidx : funcidx,
	     repr_funvar fenv a fidx /\
	     repr_val_LambdaANF_Wasm cenv fenv penv (Vfun (M.empty _) fds a)
                                            sr (f_inst f) (Val_funidx fidx)) /\

  exists main_fn e' fns,
    main_fn = {| modfunc_type := 0%N (* [] -> [] *)
               ; modfunc_locals := map (fun _ : var => T_num T_i32) (collect_local_variables e)
               ; modfunc_body := e'
               |} /\
    s_funcs sr =
    [:: FC_func_native (Tf [::] [::]) (f_inst f) main_fn
    &   map (fun f0 : wasm_function =>
             FC_func_native (Tf (repeat (T_num T_i32) (N.to_nat (type f0))) [::]) (f_inst f)
             {| modfunc_type := type f0; modfunc_locals := locals f0; modfunc_body := body f0 |})
            fns
     ] /\
  es_post = concat (mapi_aux (0, [::]) (fun n : nat => get_init_expr_elem n)
                             (table_element_mapping (Datatypes.length fns + num_custom_funs) 0)) /\
  (* links e and e' in main_fn above *)
  translate_body nenv cenv
          (create_local_variable_mapping
             (collect_local_variables e)) fenv penv e 0 = Ret e' /\
  (* translation of functions *)
  translate_functions nenv cenv fenv penv fds = Ret fns.

children.name: post_instantiation_reduce
children.statement:
Theorem post_instantiation_reduce {fenv} : forall hs sr fr fr' num_funs,
  (forall f f', M.get f fenv = Some f' -> N.to_nat f' < num_funs) ->
  INV_instantiation sr fr num_funs ->
  f_inst fr = f_inst fr' ->
  exists sr',
    reduce_trans (hs, sr, fr', [seq AI_basic i | i <- concat
                                 (mapi
                                   (fun n : nat => get_init_expr_elem n)
                                   (table_element_mapping num_funs 0))])
                 (hs, sr', fr', [::]) /\
  INV fenv sr' fr /\
  s_funcs sr = s_funcs sr'.
children.closed_by: `have H' := post_instantiation_reduce_aux ...` for the reduction and preservation facts, then re-proves `INV` by `split` into its conjuncts.
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: Running the post-instantiation instructions reaches the post-instantiation state while the invariant and the store functions are preserved.

applicability.goal_shape: A client proof needs a bundle of facts that a pipeline produces in sequence (here: compiling a LambdaANF program to a Wasm module, then instantiating it, then running the post-instantiation instructions). The interface theorem states the conjunction the client destructures, so the client never re-runs the pipeline.
applicability.use_when: several stage theorems are already proved separately and one or more clients would otherwise re-apply them in the same order; the stages have assumptions (correct_cenv_of_exp, NoDup, the bound) that the glue can discharge once for the client.
applicability.avoid_when: the stages are not yet proved separately (the interface then carries the whole proof burden at once); or different clients need different subsets of the stages, in which case each stage should stay visible rather than be hidden behind one conjunction.

The parent's site (the proof of instantiation_combined_INV_and_more) cites `post_instantiation_reduce`.

The interface's glue proof is 91 lines (2026-2116) assembled from three separately-proved stage theorems of 290, 276 and 129 lines (direct_lemmas 3, checked depth 2 via post_instantiation_reduce -> post_instantiation_reduce_aux).

The Wasm top-level correctness theorem LambdaANF_Wasm_related obtains instantiate', INV, the function-index map and the value relation by one application of instantiation_combined_INV_and_more (toplevel_theorem.v:95-97), without re-applying the three stages.

consequences: The interface theorem is a conjunction, so each conjunct becomes an obligation the client discharges by destructuring rather than by proving; the client writes no new proof for the pipeline but must keep its destructuring in sync with the interface if a stage changes. The glue assumes the three stages are already proved; if a stage's assumptions change, the single application site in the glue is the one place to update. Because the interface hides the three stages, a client that needs only one stage must either unfold the interface or reach for the stage theorem directly.
